Question 1
?

Find the general solution to the problem y″+y=8sin⁡x.

a
y=Pex+Qe−x+4sin⁡x
b
y=Pcos⁡x+Qsin⁡x−4xcos⁡x
c
y=Pcos⁡x+Qsin⁡x−2xcos⁡x+6sin⁡x
d
y=Pcos⁡x+Qsin⁡x−cos⁡x+2sin⁡x
e
y=Pex+Qxex−2cos⁡x+6sin⁡x
